title: kontour.console.economics
description: Per-run kit-economics record (flow-agents #349, console ADR 0003). Immutable per-run fact: cost, time, iterations, and defects caught. cost and defects are co-required (R7 Goodhart guard).

producer_authority.description: authenticated_runtime_binding = live authenticated session.usage Stop path; fixture_input = explicit local fixture/operator invocation, never relayed; unavailable = no attributable producer; flow_run_record = derived directly from the canonical Flow run store (.kontourai/flow/runs/<run-id>/state.json) by flow-run-economics.mjs, not from a session.usage event. Local-only: a flow_run_record producer is never console-relayed by economics-record.sh (see docs/specs/economics-record-contract.md).

terminal_status.description: Honest run-termination taxonomy (flow-agents#925), derived from the Flow run's own `status` field. 'active_abandoned' means the run was still active/blocked/needs_decision/paused when THIS record was produced -- it is NEVER reported as 'completed'. Optional/additive on v0.2 (present only on flow_run_record-produced records today); a future shape version may promote it to required.

tokens_unattributed.description: true when one or more phases[] entries carry null token fields because no token-attribution source (session.usage, or the separate economics-enrich-tokens.mjs transcript slicer) was available for them. Absence of a signal must never look like a real zero -- see phases[].items token fields, which allow null for exactly this reason. Optional/additive on v0.2.

source.description: Where this phase entry's token/cost fields came from. 'session-usage' = the legacy session.usage-event path (a single unattributed-or-phase-known bucket). 'flow-run-record' = wall_clock_s from Flow run transitions, tokens null (never fabricated; see flow-run-economics.mjs). 'transcript-slice' = tokens summed from a transcript by economics-enrich-tokens.mjs over this phase's real transition-timestamp window. Optional/additive.

delegations.description: Per-sub-agent delegation facts (#415), one entry per delegated agent_id, joined from <slug>/agents/<agent-id>/events.jsonl (latest delegation/escalation event wins for role/model; outcome derived from the agent's full event set). No per-delegation cost (no runtime isolates per-sub-agent tokens yet — see signals.per_delegation_tokens; cost-per-(role,model) is a console projection). Empty when no --agents-dir or no delegations.

dispatch_count.description: How many times the orchestrator (re)dispatched this agent_id (delegation + escalation events). >1 means it was re-prompted — an orchestrator-observable rework signal that needs no sub-agent introspection.

outcome.description: Derived ONLY from real recorded signals, never fabricated. 'unavailable' = no terminal verdict recorded on this harness, distinct from a real accept.

signals.description: What telemetry the current runtime actually exposed (harness-capability declaration — see docs/specs/harness-capability-matrix.md). Lets a consumer distinguish a real zero from a harness-blind gap.

per_delegation_tokens.description: Whether the runtime isolates per-sub-agent token usage. DERIVED (not hardcoded, #620) from the runtime's capability declaration (build/generated/capability-declarations.json, keyed on the normalized .agent.runtime with kiro-cli→kiro): true IFF the declared per_delegation_tokens status is 'supported'. An unresolved runtime or a missing declaration JSON yields the explicit sentinel false, never a fabricated true. False on every runtime today → per-delegation cost is unavailable.

per_delegation_outcome.description: Coverage of the per-delegation outcome signal on this run: full=every delegation has a real outcome; partial=some; none=delegations exist but none had a verdict/escalation; n/a=no delegations observed.

install_identity.description: Producer identity of the Flow Agents install that emitted this record (#970/#1180). The per-release effectiveness join key shared with the telemetry firehose so console#267 can segment economics by Kit version. Always present, all three fields always emitted (including the labeled unknown tuple when resolution is unavailable — never omitted, never fabricated). Resolved from scripts/telemetry/lib/install-identity.sh.
